title: PyArrow 26.0.0 contracts for a typed population carrier
question: Which PyArrow contracts decide whether a typed relation can carry, validate, identify and stream a population?
method: Compare IPC bytes of logically equal batches built by different routes and find the normalizations that equalize them. Run one Acero plan (filter, project, left-anti join, grouped aggregate) over a counting generator source in both thread modes. Read malformed JSON with an explicit schema. Check string kernel units.
conclusion: IPC bytes are not canonical for logically equal data (slices, bytes under null slots, dictionary order, chunking), so they can seal a transfer but not name content. Acero runs a fused plan lazily over a Python source, but to_reader applies no backpressure when threaded, joins and aggregates do not spill, and order is lost through joins. The JSON reader with an explicit schema rejects unknown, missing-required, mistyped, overflowing and duplicate-key input and merges absent with null. validate(full=True) does not enforce non-nullable fields.
